notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Duck Force
notes.content:
Duck Force is Now Available on Steam!

Experience an amazing adventure in the rough stone age, where the bunny people under rule of a maniacal leader strives for the absolute power. Fly through dry deserts and rocky canyons full of challenges and evolve from a lame duck to a majestic flight artists.

notes.title: Duck Force - Update 0.2 | September 22, 2016
notes.content:
I am pleased to announce that I have just released a major update to  [b]Duck Force![/b]
Thank you for all the very positive and very supportive reviews.
It’s great to see that people are enjoying the game. 

[h1][u]Updates and changes include:[/u][/h1]
[list]
[*] Graphic Improvements (SSAO, Bloom and Lens Fx)
[*] Added second level, (Ready To Play)
[*] Added Linux / Steamplay Support 
[*] Added more FX for more fun 
[*] Updated teleportation to allow teleporting to any surface
  (with height-collision detection and offset to geometrie)
[*] Improved "Fly With Duck" FPS Mode
[*] Fixed collision issues on bullets and some objects 
[*] Fixed a lot of small Bugs

Level 1:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CMb2y_UNcJY
Level 2:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dx4KWhiTcTA
